በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')

እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ዘይትወለድ: ተወልደ — who is born (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ወለደ) · 'that which is born' (neuter, ዘ- 'that which')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ · also after a verbal noun ('fasting for God', 'offering to God') and as the owner after an anticipating suffix (ፈቃዱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'God's will')
ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
መድኀኒቶሙ: መድኀኒት — their salvation (noun + -ሙ 'their') · 'their saviour', the abstract noun said of a person (ይጸልኡ መድኀኒቶሙ 'they will hate their saviour')
ለእስራኤል: እስራኤል — to Israel, O Israel (ለ- + proper name) · over Israel (ይነግሥ ለእስራኤል 'he shall reign over Israel') · marking the object after ወአኅለፎሙ 'and he made them pass, Israel' · ለ- marking the possessor after a noun (እከዮሙ ለእስራኤል 'their evil, (that) of Israel')
እምእደ: እድ — from the hand of (እም- + noun, construct)
ወለደቶ: ወለደ — she bore him (3fs perfect ወለደት + -ኦ 'him', joined as ቶ)
እምባዕድ: ባዕድ — from a foreign, other (እም- 'from' + ባዕድ 'other, foreign', adjective)
ወቤተ: ቤት — and the house of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)
ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son') · give him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ሀብ + -ኦ '3ms him', ወሀቦ ወለተከ 'give him your daughter')
ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
መጽሐፈ: መጽሐፍ — a book (noun, accusative) · construct 'book of' (መጽሐፈ ሕግ 'the book of the law', ch. 55)
ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ወአውሰበ: አውሰበ — and he married (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
አዋልደ: ወለት — daughters of (noun, plural አዋልድ, construct)
ቈላፋን: ቈላፍ — uncircumcised ones, gentiles (adjective/noun, plural ቈላፋን)
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ተምዕዖ: ተምዕዐ — he was angry at him (3ms perfect + -ሁ '3ms him', Gt, m-ʿ-ʿ) (?)
ለሰብአ: ሰብእ — the men of (ለ- + noun, construct 'men-of'; the ለ- marks the object, doubling the suffix on the verb)
ወቀተሎሙ: ቀተለ — and he killed them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
ቀተሎሙ: ቀተለ — he killed them (3ms perfect, G, q-t-l, + -ሙ '3mp them')
ወበእብን: እብን — and with stone (ወ- + በ- + እብን 'stone', noun)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
አንበጣ: አንበጣ — locust (noun; collective, accusative after the numeral)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
እምግብርናተ: ግብርና — from the servitude of (እም- + ግብርናት, construct) (?)
ፅንስት: ፅንስት — pregnant (adjective, fem. sg.; of ፀንሰ 'conceive')
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')

ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ወሰመየቶ: ሰመየ — and she named him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
ቀተሎ: ቀተለ — he killed him (3m sg perfect + -o, q-t-l)
ለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — of/for the king of (ለ- + construct)
ቤት: ቤት — house (noun) · construct 'house of' (ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory'; ሰብአ ቤት 'men of the house')
ወለሊሁኒ: ለሊሁ — and he himself also (ወ- + ለሊ 'self' + -ሁ '3ms' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ወገብአት: ገብአ — she returned (3fs perfect, G, g-b-ʾ; ወ- 'and')
ንግሥተ: ንግሥት — queen (noun, fem.; construct 'queen of' before the following noun)
ክልኤሆን: ክልኤቱ — both of them (feminine; numeral 'two' + -ሆን '3fp', of the hands)

እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
እም: እም — mother (noun; ከመ እም 'as a mother')
ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
ለእም: እም — to the mother (ለ- + noun; 'belongs to the mother')
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ኅቡረ: ኅቡር — together (accusative as adverb; from ኅብረ/ኅቡር)
ወመንግሥትሰ: መንግሥት — and as for the kingdom (ወ- + noun + emphatic -ሰ)
እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
ተርፉ: ተረፈ — they remained (3mp perfect, G, t-r-f)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
እምደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — from the sons of (እም- 'from' + plural construct 'sons of')
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ወይብልዋ: ብህለ — and they will say to her, call her (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዋ '3fs her', b-h-l)
ነግሀ: ነግህ — dawn (noun, accusative ነግሀ, used adverbially 'at dawn') (?); also 3ms perfect ነግሀ 'it dawned'
ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
ዘወፅአ: ወፅአ — that which went out (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)

አሠነየ: አሠነየ — he made good, did well (3ms perfect, causative of ሠነየ 'be fair')
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ዘያነሥኦ: አንሥአ — who raises him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, causative of ንሥአ 'rise' + -ኦ '3ms him')
ላዕሌነ: ላዕለ — upon us (preposition, stem ላዕሌ- + -ነ '1cp us')
ወእመሂ: እመ — and whether, or whether (ወ- 'and' + conjunction እመ + enclitic -ሂ)
ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ)
ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
ወለደት: ወለደ — she bore, gave birth (3fs perfect)
ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')

ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ወገነዩ: ገነየ — and they did homage, served (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')

ለደቂቆን: ደቂቅ — sons, children (ለ- marking the object, in apposition to the suffix on ይውግራሆሙ + plural ደቂቅ + -ሆን 'their', 3fp, contracted to -ኦን)
